277303559.description: This is a polished petrified wood stone specimen measuring approximately 2 inches by 2.5 inches by 0.5 inches. The stone is oval-shaped with a blend of dark brown, reddish, and tan hues featuring natural striations and patterns. It has a glossy, polished surface with no significant chips or cracks, and appears to be in very good, unused condition. The specimen is presented in a silver-colored textured gift box with a white satin interior lining. The box is labeled with the code 'SN1001'. There are no visible maker's marks or brand names on the stone. Suitable for display, gifting, or metaphysical use.

277848783.description: This is a carved figurine of a kitsune made from dumortierite in quartz stone. The kitsune is a spiritual fox often depicted with nine tails in folklore. The carving measures approximately 2 x 2.10 x 1.85 inches and weighs about 153.3 grams. The stone features a pattern with blue streaks and lighter gray areas. The figure has closed eyes and prominent ears, carved in a stylized form. The bottom of the piece is cut flat to allow for display.
